column1: # Ground-command tokens: the digest both ends must compute from a password and a packet
# number. Read by the C++ suite and by the web console's Node tests, so the two
# implementations of FNV-1a cannot drift apart without a build failing.
# The last row is deliberately non-ASCII: the token is computed over UTF-8 bytes, and a
# JavaScript implementation that hashed UTF-16 code units would agree on every other row
a longer pass phrase with spaces
